[[Hank MacLean]] - co-husband |TV actor =[[Diego Borborema]] }} '''Bert''' was a resident of [[Vault 33]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== He married [[Steph Harper]] on March 17, [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2294|2294]] and they consummated their marriage the same night, with Steph commenting that her wedding dress "got off almost as fast as Burt{{sic}} did."[[Lucy MacLean]]: ''"Hmm. Feels a little tight."''
[[Steph Harper]]: ''"Won't be for long. On my wedding night, that dress got off almost as fast as Burt{{sic}} did."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) By 2296, they had conceived their first child.[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' Season 1 character introductions on Amazon]], [[Steph Harper]]: ''A resident of Vault 33, Steph is Lucy’s best friend. She and her husband, Bert, were married in 2294. They are currently expecting their first child, but that doesn’t stop Steph from taking part in the Young Pipefitter’s Association or any of her other Vault duties.'' Per Steph's description, Bert was very fond of his shoes and kept them in very good condition; he would also talk about them so much to the point that he would bore everyone around him into leaving. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Bert is part of the group that welcomes the Vault 32 dwellers into Vault 33 on the day of [[Lucy MacLean]]'s wedding. When they see Lucy's soon-to-be husband [[Monty (TV series)|Monty]], Steph comments, "Lucky," with Bert giving her an appalled look from behind while Steph smiles, seemingly satisfied with his reaction. During the wedding reception in the atrium cornfield, Steph and Bert sit at the same table with Lucy and Monty. After [[Overseer]] [[Hank MacLean]] gives his speech, Bert and Steph are seen dancing in the background. The Vault 32 dwellers later reveal themselves to be raiders, indiscriminately attacking the Vault 33 dwellers. Bert is caught in the chaos and is killed after his neck is sliced by one of the raiders. Steph is seen cradling his corpse before attacking the raiders, driven by grief and rage. This causes her to be stabbed in the eye with a fork, though she manages to grab a submachine gun and kill at least one raider. ==Notes== A portrait of his face is shown in "[[The Ghouls]]." ==Appearances== Bert appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==Behind the scenes== * Steph's description on Amazon once said Bert was originally a resident of [[Vault 32]] who was traded to Vault 33 as a "breeder" in exchange for some of Vault 33's mechanical and agricultural resources. However, this would raise questions as to why Bert did not recognize [[Lee Moldaver]] or any of her raiders from Vault 32. The description was later updated to never mention where Bert is from, making it possible that it was an error or something that was retconned out. The edit also removed a line calling Steph a "native resident of Vault 33." {{Transcript|text=A native resident of Vault 33, Steph is Lucy’s best friend. She is married to Bert, a breeder from Vault 32 who was traded for some of Vault 33’s agricultural and mechanical resources. They are currently expecting their first child, but that doesn’t stop Steph from taking part in the Young Pipefitter’s Association or any of her other Vault duties.|Original [[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|Amazon Prime character intro transcript]]}} * In the subtitles for "[[The End (episode)|The End]]," he is named Burt with a u in it; this is most likely an error, as in other episodes, as well as the preview of Steph Harper on the ''Fallout'' Season 1 page on Amazon, he is named Bert with an e in it. * In Prime Video X-Ray, [[Anthony Misiano]] was initially miscredited as Bert. Meanwhile, [[Diego Borborema]] posted behind-the-scenes photos of himself as Bert on Instagram to confirm his role.[https://www.instagram.com/p/C5tdAZcA2FM/?img_index=1 Diego Borborema's Instagram post] The mistake was corrected on Prime Video by May 5, 2024. ==Gallery== FOTV S01E01.The.End.
